id: \bHello there. Would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
en: \bHello there. Would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
it: \bSalve. Vuoi che alleni uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
en: \bOh?  But you only have one Pokémon with you.
it: \bOh?  Ma hai un solo Pokémon con te.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
it: \bQuale Pokémon vuoi che alleni?

id: \bVery well.
en: \bVery well.
it: \bMolto bene.

id: \bIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
en: \bIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
it: \bSe mi lasci quel Pokémon, con cosa lotterai?

id: \bCome back when you have enough to make it out there.
en: \bCome back when you have enough to make it out there.
it: \bTorna quando ne avrai abbastanza per cavartela là fuori.

id: \bI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \bI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
it: \bAllenerò il tuo \v[3] per un po'.

id: \bI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?
en: \bI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?
it: \bPosso allenare due dei tuoi Pokémon. Vuoi che ne alleni un altro?

id: \bYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
en: \bYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
it: \bNon puoi andartene in giro senza un Pokémon. Torna un'altra volta.

id: \bWhich Pokémon should I raise for you?
en: \bWhich Pokémon should I raise for you?
it: \bQuale Pokémon devo allenare per te?

id: \bI can always train one for you.
en: \bI can always train one for you.
it: \bPosso sempre allenartene uno.

id: \bCome back another time.
en: \bCome back another time.
it: \bTorna un'altra volta.

id: \bCome back for it later.
en: \bCome back for it later.
it: \bTorna a prenderlo più tardi.

id: \bHello \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
en: \bHello \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
it: \bCiao, \PN. Come va? Il tuo Pokémon è diventato più forte.

id: \bBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
en: \bBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
it: \bIl tuo \v[3] è salito di circa \v[4] livelli.

id: \bDo you want your Pokémon back?
en: \bDo you want your Pokémon back?
it: \bVuoi riavere il tuo Pokémon?

id: \bYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
en: \bYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
it: \bLa tua squadra è al completo. Fai spazio, poi torna da me.

id: Which one do you want back?
en: Which one do you want back?
it: Quale vuoi riprenderti?

id: \G\bIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
en: \G\bIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
it: \G\bSe vuoi riavere il tuo \v[3], ti costerà $\v[4].

id: \G\bYou don't have enough money...
en: \G\bYou don't have enough money...
it: \G\bNon hai abbastanza soldi...

id: \G\bWonderful\nHere's your Pokémon.
en: \G\bWonderful\nHere's your Pokémon.
it: \G\bMeraviglioso\nEcco il tuo Pokémon.

id: \PN took \v[3] back from the aid.
en: \PN took \v[3] back from the aid.
it: \PN ha ripreso \v[3] dall'assistente.

id: \bDo you want to take back the other one, too?
en: \bDo you want to take back the other one, too?
it: \bVuoi riprenderti anche l'altro?

id: It's a Pokédex. Better leave it alone.
en: It's a Pokédex. Better leave it alone.
it: È un Pokédex. Meglio non toccarlo.

id: \rJuniper: I have an aide here that will help raise your Pokémon. Feel free to ask them.
en: \rJuniper: I have an aide here that will help raise your Pokémon. Feel free to ask them.
it: \rAralia: Qui ho un assistente che può aiutarti ad allevare i tuoi Pokémon. Chiedigli pure.

id: \rJuniper: You found Oshawott? The little guy is supposed to be for beginning Trainers. If it likes you that much though, you can take it.
en: \rJuniper: You found Oshawott? The little guy is supposed to be for beginning Trainers. If it likes you that much though, you can take it.
it: \rAralia: Hai trovato Oshawott? Quel piccoletto sarebbe destinato agli Allenatori alle prime armi. Ma se ti è così affezionato, puoi tenerlo.

id: \rJuniper: Good, you're here. I see you got my message.
en: \rJuniper: Good, you're here. I see you got my message.
it: \rAralia: Bene, sei arrivato. Vedo che hai ricevuto il mio messaggio.

id: \rThere's a town south of Virbank City. It has a new gym leader who could use some practice. I was hoping you could help him.
en: \rThere's a town south of Virbank City. It has a new gym leader who could use some practice. I was hoping you could help him.
it: \rC'è una città a sud di Virbopoli. Ha un nuovo Capopalestra a cui farebbe comodo un po' di pratica. Speravo che potessi aiutarlo.

id: \rThere's also been sighting of a strong legendary Pokémon. Feel free to try and capture it.
en: \rThere's also been sighting of a strong legendary Pokémon. Feel free to try and capture it.
it: \rInoltre, è stato avvistato un potente Pokémon leggendario. Prova pure a catturarlo.

id: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
en: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
it: I tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati completamente.

id: \bOak: It sounds like a wonderful plan. I look forward to it.
en: \bOak: It sounds like a wonderful plan. I look forward to it.
it: \bOak: Mi sembra un piano magnifico. Non vedo l'ora.

id: \bOak: Good, you're here \PN. This is Professor Juniper, an old friend of mine.
en: \bOak: Good, you're here \PN. This is Professor Juniper, an old friend of mine.
it: \bOak: Bene, sei arrivato \PN. Lei è la Professoressa Aralia, una mia vecchia amica.

id: \rJuniper: Welcome to Unova. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
en: \rJuniper: Welcome to Unova. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
it: \rAralia: Benvenuto a Unima. Spero che il soggiorno qui ti piaccia.

id: \rIf you ever need anything feel free to ask.
en: \rIf you ever need anything feel free to ask.
it: \rSe mai avessi bisogno di qualcosa, chiedi pure.

id: \bYes, yes, Juniper and I were going to catch up for a while before I return home. I'm sure you're anxious to challenge a Gym. Don't let us hold you back.
en: \bYes, yes, Juniper and I were going to catch up for a while before I return home. I'm sure you're anxious to challenge a Gym. Don't let us hold you back.
it: \bSì, sì, Aralia e io volevamo fare due chiacchiere prima che io torni a casa. Sono sicuro che non vedi l'ora di sfidare una Palestra. Non lasciare che ti tratteniamo.

en: \bOak: The Unova League sounds like a good challenge for you. I look forward to hearing your results.
it: \bOak: La Lega di Unima mi sembra una bella sfida per te. Non vedo l'ora di sapere come andrà.
